stories.title: Regional productivity gaps narrowing in India's smallest businesses
stories.summary: New data from the Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises indicates regional productivity gaps are narrowing, with manufacturing leading gains. The survey covers roughly 10.24 crore MSMEs, providing an unfiltered reality check on the sector. Challenges still keep the smallest businesses from scaling to their full potential.

stories.title: Manufacturing sector highlighted as pillar of self-reliance
stories.summary: As India marks its 80th Independence Day, the government credits reforms under the Make in India vision for positioning the nation as a global manufacturing hub. Initiatives including the Production Linked Incentive scheme and PM GatiShakti aim to further accelerate momentum in sectors like electronics and pharmaceuticals.

stories.title: Air India pushes pilots for fuel efficiency
stories.summary: Air India has urged A320 pilots to adopt measures like single-engine taxiing and efficient climb profiles to curtail costs and reduce wastage. The airline says the drive highlights both operational and environmental benefits. The carrier is currently pursuing a wider push to reduce its overall expenditure.

stories.title: CII to open artisan centre in Varanasi
stories.summary: Industry body CII will establish an artisan design and development centre in Varanasi to provide market access and skills to 75,000 artisans over five years. The initiative is part of the inaugural CII Banaras Biennale, which launches next month at the city's Trade Facilitation Centre.

stories.title: INERA introduces new biostimulants for crop performance
stories.summary: INERA has launched a range of crop solutions, including its patented enzyme-driven biostimulant BioMorphX. The company says the product activates the root zone from day zero to ensure stronger roots and more even crops. The launch series, titled NAVODAYA 2026, also introduced new speciality fertilizers to dealers.

stories.title: Global audit entities to examine AI in compliance
stories.summary: The Compliance Audit Subcommittee of the International Organization of Supreme Audit Institutions has prioritized exploring artificial intelligence for 2026-28. Officials say AI offers significant opportunities to analyze large volumes of information and identify patterns. The subcommittee is one of five global entities examining the technology's risks.

stories.title: RBI to strengthen credit infrastructure for MSMEs
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India plans to bolster credit infrastructure to help small businesses compete globally. Governor Sanjay Malhotra noted that these ventures provide jobs to 450 million people and account for nearly half of India's merchandise exports. New trade agreements are expected to provide access to markets.

stories.title: Schaeffler India promoter sells 6.49% stake for ₹3,549 crore - ET Auto
Verizon in talks to acquire Fidium for $6 billion
stories.summary: Verizon is reportedly in discussions to acquire broadband operator Fidium in a deal valued at $6 billion. The move would allow the mobile giant to expand its network and target more internet service subscribers across the US. The companies have not yet reached a final agreement.

stories.title: Intermex sues Western Union over terminated merger
stories.summary: Intermex is suing Western Union to enforce a $500 million merger agreement. Western Union abandoned the deal after facing regulatory conditions. The lawsuit seeks to hold the company to the terms of the original agreement.

stories.title: India markets end week as worst performer
stories.summary: Domestic equities snapped a four-week winning streak as investors booked profits, making India the worst-performing major equity market of the week. Despite foreign portfolio investors buying 31,500 crore rupees worth of equities, both the Nifty and Sensex declined nearly 1.2 percent on Friday.

stories.title: NCLT waives meetings for Disney India merger
stories.summary: The Mumbai bench of the National Company Law Tribunal has allowed three Disney group companies to dispense with shareholder and creditor meetings. The tribunal noted that 100 percent of the transferee company's equity shareholders have already consented to the proposed scheme of arrangement and amalgamation.

stories.title: India's CCI clears Samara Capital's ₹1,200 crore logistics merger - Dealroom
Vijaya Diagnostic Centre completes Guwahati acquisition
stories.summary: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre has completed its acquisition of the integrated diagnostic business of Arya Wellness Centre in Guwahati. The company assumed full operational and management control on 26 November for a lump-sum consideration of 46.20 crore rupees. The acquired business reported a turnover of 26.95 crore rupees.

stories.title: Sensex drops 989 points as profit booking hits markets
stories.summary: The Sensex fell 989 points on Friday, snapping a two-day rally as investors booked profits in IT and banking shares. Rising crude oil prices and a weaker rupee also weighed on sentiment. The Nifty index declined to 25,607, ending a week of losses for Indian equities.

stories.title: National Stock Exchange share price update
stories.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India share price was down 0.07 percent from its previous closing price of 2,348.60 rupees. The exchange operates alongside peers including BSE Ltd and Multi Commodity Exchange of India Ltd. Its promoters include Ashishkumar Chauhan and Rajesh Gopinathan.

stories.title: Pulse of the Street: Profit booking snaps four-week rally, markets brace consolidation? | Stock Market News
stories.summary: Domestic equities snapped a four-week winning streak as investors booked profits following a sharp month-long rally. The Nifty 50 and Sensex declined 0.7-0.8% during the week, despite foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) buying nearly ₹31,500 crore worth of Indian equities, according to data from National Securities Depository Ltd. Both indices fell

stories.title: IT and financial stocks drag indices lower
stories.summary: Indian equity benchmarks ended their two-session winning streak on Friday as selling pressure in heavyweight stocks accelerated. The Sensex fell 989 points to settle at 83,339, while the Nifty closed at 25,607. Rising crude oil prices and a weaker rupee contributed to the decline.

stories.title: Sensex sinks nearly 1,000 points as crude and rupee weigh on markets
stories.summary: Indian equity markets snapped a two-session winning streak on Friday as profit booking, rising crude oil prices and a weaker rupee dragged benchmark indices lower. The Sensex fell nearly 1,000 points, while the Nifty slipped below 25,650. Selling pressure was broad across banking, technology and automobile sectors.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields shares make muted market debut
stories.summary: Shares of Mahanadi Coalfields, a subsidiary of Coal India, ended their first day of trading at a discount. The stock closed at 132.50 rupees on the NSE, roughly 2.57 percent below its 136 rupee issue price. The company is the country's largest coal-producing subsidiary.

stories.title: Sensex sheds 989 points as four-week Nifty rally ends
stories.summary: Benchmarks snapped a four-week winning streak as rising crude prices and a weaker rupee weighed on sentiment. The Sensex fell 989.33 points to settle at 83,339.26, while the Nifty 50 declined 1.07 percent. Some investors rotated funds away from Indian IT stocks toward global technology markets.

stories.title: Dollar tracks toward longest monthly winning streak in two years
stories.summary: The dollar is on track for a third straight month of gains, rising 1.9 percent in November. The currency has strengthened against all Group-of-10 peers, supported by robust economic growth and inflation. A slump in technology stocks has further encouraged a flight to safe-haven assets.

stories.title: Gold pares gains as Federal Reserve outlook keeps investors cautious
stories.summary: Gold pared gains on Friday as a firm dollar and rising Treasury yields tempered earlier optimism. Despite the pullback, the metal remains on track for its first weekly gain in three weeks. Bargain-buying helped lift prices from a 15-month low hit earlier in the week.

stories.title: Canadian dollar holds weekly gains on rate hike bets
stories.summary: The Canadian dollar is set to snap a three-week losing streak as investors anticipate a December rate hike from the Bank of Canada. The currency traded near 1.4245 per US dollar. Governor Tiff Macklem recently underscored the bank's concerns regarding persistent inflation pressures across the economy.

stories.title: OPEC+ expected to maintain steady oil production targets
stories.summary: OPEC+ is reportedly set to keep production targets unchanged for the first quarter of 2027. The group is currently reviewing member capacity, though internal disputes over estimates have complicated discussions. Oil ministers are scheduled to hold a series of meetings this Sunday to finalize the output strategy.

stories.title: Copper jumps as China signals stock market support
stories.summary: Copper prices rose 4.4 percent on the London Metal Exchange, marking the largest percentage gain since February. The move followed a call from the Chinese cabinet for state-backed investors to steady the stock market. The metal had previously hit an 11-month low on Wednesday.

stories.title: RBI consolidates card payment circulars into single framework
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has combined 25 existing circulars governing debit, credit and prepaid card transactions into a single regulatory framework. The new directions aim to streamline compliance and security rules for digital payments. The notification does not introduce new requirements for end users.

stories.title: RBI reduces minimum daily CRR maintenance requirement
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has lowered the minimum daily cash reserve ratio maintenance from 99 percent to 90 percent, effective December 1. The central bank cited current macroeconomic conditions and liquidity. Banking system liquidity recently turned to deficit following tax outflows and foreign exchange interventions.

stories.title: RBI consolidates ATM withdrawal rules and fee caps
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has unified rules for ATM and point-of-sale cash withdrawals. The new framework retains existing free transaction limits and caps additional charges at 23 rupees. The move is intended to provide greater clarity regarding transaction fees and guidelines for failed withdrawals.

stories.title: RBI repatriates 60 tonnes of gold to domestic vaults
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has moved 60 tonnes of gold back to domestic vaults, bringing the total held in India to 84 percent of its reserves. The remaining 140.39 tonnes remain stored with the Bank of England and the Bank for International Settlements.

stories.title: RBI increases domestic gold reserve holdings
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India brought 60 tonnes of gold back to India between April and September 2026. Domestic holdings now total 740.13 metric tonnes, representing 84 percent of the central bank's total reserves. Officials described the repatriation as part of a regular reserve management process.

stories.title: RBI lowers daily CRR maintenance to 90 percent
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has reduced the minimum daily cash reserve ratio requirement for scheduled banks from 99 percent to 90 percent, effective December 1. This reverses a directive from October that had raised the daily minimum to 99 percent to manage liquidity conditions.

stories.title: RBI sets time-bound process for banks to freeze suspicious accounts, mandates 7-day response window for customers - Mone
UPI expands reach to 11 countries
stories.summary: India's Unified Payments Interface is now accepted in 11 countries, with Greece and the Maldives being the latest to adopt the platform. Developed by the National Payments Corporation of India, the system has become the primary vehicle for the country's digital payments ecosystem over the past decade.

stories.title: RBI updates ATM and card transaction rules
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has consolidated its rules for ATM withdrawals and card payments. The number of free monthly ATM transactions remains unchanged at five for own-bank machines. Banks may charge up to 23 rupees plus taxes for additional transactions. The rules are now consolidated.

stories.title: RBI consolidates ATM and PoS withdrawal directions
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has issued consolidated directions for ATM and PoS cash withdrawals, effective immediately. Savings account holders are entitled to five free monthly transactions at their own bank ATMs. Limits for other banks vary by location, capped at five total. The rules are now consolidated.

stories.title: Government confirms UPI payments remain free
stories.summary: The Finance Ministry stated that UPI will remain free for consumers and person-to-person transactions. Any future merchant discount rate charges would apply only to a limited set of transactions above a specific threshold. The amendment aims to ensure long-term sustainability for the platform.

stories.title: RBI issues new card-based transaction directions
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has released consolidated directions for card-based transactions, replacing 25 earlier circulars. The rules cover EMV chip standards, credit card network selection, and security requirements. The regulator aims to streamline compliance for payment system providers and participants through these new digital payment standards.

stories.title: RBI consolidates ATM and PoS withdrawal rules
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has issued new master directions for ATM and PoS cash withdrawals, withdrawing 17 previous circulars. Banks are now required to inform customers about their free transaction usage and any applicable charges. The regulator is simplifying the rules for banks and customers alike.

stories.title: Axis Mutual Fund launches Nifty LargeMidcap 250 Index Fund
stories.summary: Axis Mutual Fund has opened its Nifty LargeMidcap 250 Index Fund for subscription until December 11. The open-ended equity scheme aims to replicate the performance of the underlying benchmark index. It follows a passive investment strategy, matching the weightage of stocks in the Nifty LargeMidcap 250 Index.

stories.title: Study compares direct and regular mutual fund plans
stories.summary: A report by Wealthy-Monitor Deloitte suggests that investors in regular mutual fund plans tend to hold their investments longer than those in direct plans. While direct plans offer lower expense ratios, regular plans provide distributor support. The study questions if the additional cost of guidance is justified.

stories.title: Calculating monthly withdrawals for retirement
stories.summary: Withdrawing from a retirement corpus requires balancing monthly income needs against investment returns and inflation. A withdrawal rate exceeding the returns generated by the corpus can lead to premature depletion of savings. Planning for a 20-year period depends entirely on the chosen investment strategy and withdrawal amount.

stories.title: EPFO hosts Nidhi Aapke Nikat awareness camps
stories.summary: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation is conducting Nidhi Aapke Nikat camps across India to provide grievance redressal and information on schemes. The body has provided a list of camp locations to help members find their nearest venue. Multiple sessions are being held in major cities.

stories.title: Court rules married daughters can claim compensation
stories.summary: The Delhi High Court ruled that married or financially independent daughters retain the right to claim compensation for a parent's death. Financial dependency is not a prerequisite for filing claims under the Motor Vehicles Act. The ruling clarifies that marital status does not exclude legal representatives.

stories.title: Gold loan borrowers face margin money demands
stories.summary: Gold prices have fallen over 30 percent from their January 2026 peak, leading banks to demand additional margin money from borrowers. Customers are struggling to maintain prescribed loan-to-value ratios. While the price drop benefits new buyers, those with existing gold-backed loans are facing financial distress.

stories.title: Gold loan auctions rise as prices fall
stories.summary: Gold loan auctions at Manappuram Finance increased to 100 crore in the September quarter, up from 25 crore in June. Gold prices are down 28 percent from their January high. Executives warn that further price declines could lead to more auctions for borrowers who have pledged their gold.

stories.title: SEBI warns investors against Grey Market Premium
stories.summary: SEBI has cautioned investors against relying on unofficial Grey Market Premium figures to assess IPO listings. The regulator stated these figures are unregulated and lack settlement guarantees. Registered intermediaries have been advised to stop circulating such data, as transactions occur outside the regulated stock market framework.

stories.title: SEBI proposes faster FPI and trust listings
stories.summary: SEBI plans to shorten FPI registration to five business days and halve listing timelines for REITs and InvITs to three days. Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated these proposals aim to simplify market regulations. The regulator is also reviewing listing obligations and disclosure requirements for listed companies.

stories.title: SEBI aims to streamline FPI onboarding
stories.summary: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced plans to reduce FPI onboarding time to five business days using digital workflows. The regulator proposed removing additional disclosures to align with global standards. Around 740 FPIs have registered under the SWAGAT-FI system, which offers simpler compliance and longer KYC cycles.

stories.title: SEBI clarifies MD age limit for market institutions
stories.summary: SEBI clarified that its recent consultation paper on market infrastructure institutions does not propose changing the 65-year age limit for managing directors. The regulator noted that some media reports misinterpreted the document. Provisions not mentioned in the paper are intended to remain unchanged.

stories.title: SEBI eases KYC review cycles for FPIs
stories.summary: SEBI has issued a circular to rationalise periodic KYC requirements for foreign portfolio investors, effective December 1. The new rules extend review cycles to eight years for many categories of investors. The change aims to reduce paperwork and frequency of check-ins for regulated entities and government investors.

stories.title: SEBI requires merchant bankers to register as valuers
stories.summary: SEBI clarified on 16 November 2026 that merchant bankers performing valuation work must register as valuers. This applies even when other laws already recognise them as eligible professionals for such tasks. The guidance was issued to Navigant Corporate Advisors Limited. The overlap in requirements is now official.

stories.title: Whistleblower mechanisms under Indian corporate law
stories.summary: Corporate governance frameworks in India require companies to maintain vigil mechanisms under the Companies Act 2013 and SEBI regulations. These systems allow stakeholders to report misconduct and internal policy violations without fear of retaliation. Companies are expected to use these tools to identify governance failures early.
